# SRFI-1 procedure links

Import `:std/srfi/1` to use these procedures.

These links point to procedure definitions in the original [SRFI-1 List Library](https://srfi.schemers.org/srfi-1/srfi-1.html) by Olin Shivers. They are an index of the specification, not a copy of its text or a claim that Gerbil has no implementation differences.
